hints.title: Local Extremum Definition
hints.text: A digit forms a local peak if it is strictly greater than both its adjacent neighbors, and a local valley if strictly less.

hints.title: Short Number Invariance
hints.text: Any number with fewer than 3 decimal digits has a waviness score of 0.

hints.title: Range Summation
hints.text: Iterate through each number in the bounded interval, evaluating and accumulating internal peaks and valleys.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct digit evaluation per integer across the range.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Unavoidable per-number digit inspection for small range queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Define peak/valley condition clearly and iterate cleanly.
